description: Portronics Konnect B Type-C to Type-C Cable (1.5M, 100W) — designed for power, speed, and durability. With 100W Power Delivery and 5A current output, this cable ensures super-fast charging for all your USB-C devices including laptops, smartphones, tablets, and more. It features an intelligent E-Marker chipset that automatically regulates voltage and current for safe and efficient performance, protecting your gadgets from overheating and overcharging. Built with a tough nylon-braided exterior and reinforced connectors, Konnect B offers exceptional durability and a 10,000+ bend lifespan, ensuring long-term use without fraying or tangling. Apart from charging, it also supports high-speed 480Mbps data transfer, letting you sync large files, photos, and videos in seconds. Its 1.5-metre length strikes the perfect balance between flexibility and convenience — ideal for home, office, or travel use. Whether you’re powering up a MacBook, iPad, Samsung, OnePlus, or any Type-C device, the Konnect B delivers consistent, reliable, and lightning-fast performance every time.
